verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              तस्मिन्नहनि निर्वृत्ते द्वितीये समुपस्थिते। आपूर्यत महारङ्गः पौरैर्युद्धदिदृक्षुभिः॥१॥
सचित्राष्टास्रिचरणाः सार्गलद्वारवेदिकाः। सगवाक्षार्धचन्द्राश्च सुतल्पोत्तमभूषिताः॥२॥
verses.english: How and why god धन्वन्तरि incarnated as human... I would like to listen about it... please tell me the details...
verses.bhavadeepa: एकोनत्रिंशे कंसेभप्रमुखस्याथ मारणम्। श्रीकृष्णेन कुवलयापीडनाम्नो निरूप्यते॥१॥ तस्मिन् इति॥१॥

verses.sanskrit: प्राङ्मुखैश्चारुनिर्मुक्तैर्माल्यदामावतंसितैः। अलङ्कृतैर्विराजद्भिः शारदैरिव तोयदैः॥३॥
verses.english: Deciding in this way that king egotistical of his kingship brought down the temple establishment of that demigod with certain disesteem...
verses.bhavadeepa: यत्र मञ्चाः भान्ति स समाजवाटः, प्राङ्मुखैर्मञ्चागारैः शुशुभे इति पञ्चमचतुर्थतृतीयस्थानां पादानां सम्बन्धः। तत्र मञ्चाः कीदृशा इत्यत आह- द्वितीयेन श्लोकेन- सचित्रेति। चित्रसहिताः सचित्राः अष्टास्त्रयो अष्टकोणाश्चरणा येषां ते सचित्राष्टास्त्रिचरणाः॥२॥

verses.sanskrit: मञ्चागारैः सुनिर्युक्तैर्युद्धाय सुविभूषितैः। समाजवाटः शुशुभे समेघौघ इवार्णवः॥४॥
verses.english: Your husband, महेश्वर, is an eternalized good-for-nothing fellow... he and his gang - all are with outr behaviour, and none can bring him around to conduct himself with some etiquette...
verses.bhavadeepa: निर्मुक्तैः विरलतन्तुभिरन्तःपटैर्युक्तानि मञ्चागाराणि येषु स्थिताः राजदाराः सर्वं बहिःस्थं पश्यन्ति बाह्याश्च तान्न पश्यन्ति तादृशैश्चारुनिर्मुक्तैः॥३॥

verses.sanskrit: स्वकर्मद्रव्ययुक्ताभिः पताकाभिर्निरन्तरम्। श्रेणीनां च गणा नां च मञ्चा भान्त्यचलोपमाः॥५॥
verses.english: Nikumbha, the god in the idol, avoided giving the king any progeny on certain ground and he said to himself, This king should cut up rough with us... then only our mission is feasible... let him loose temper first...
verses.bhavadeepa: सुनिर्युक्तैः शोभना निर्युक्ताः मल्लादयो येषु तैः॥४॥

verses.sanskrit: अन्तःपुरचराणां च प्रेक्षागाराण्यनेकशः। रेजुः काञ्चनचित्राणि रत्नज्वालाकुलानि च॥६॥
verses.english: dhanvantari then said to viShNu, Oh, god, whether it is ocean or otherwhere, I am your son आपो नरा प्रोक्ता - pray allot me a place at your feet, and make me eligible for some dole from vedic rituals...
verses.bhavadeepa: स्वकर्मद्रव्ययुक्ताभिः यस्य शिल्पवतो यदुपकरणद्रव्यं तेन चिह्निताभिः, श्रेणीनाम् अनेकजातीनामप्येकशिल्पोपजीविनां गणानाम् एकजातीनाम्॥५॥

verses.sanskrit: तानि रत्नौघक्लृप्तानि ससानुप्रग्रहाणि च। रेजुर्जवनिकाक्षेपैः सपक्षा इव खे नगाः॥७॥
verses.english: गृत्स-मदस् brAhmaNa son is शुनक whose sons are शौनक-s who also are brAhmaNa-s, whereas the other descendants of गृत्स-मद have become kshatriya-s, vaishya-s and even shUdrA-s...

verses.sanskrit: तत्र चामरहारैश्च भुषणानां च सिञ्जितैः। वाणीनां च विचित्राणां विचित्राश्चेरुरर्चिषः॥८॥
verses.english: The lineage of शल, the second son of सुनहोत्र, is like this: शल --> अर्ष्टिषेण --> काशक --> काशय, or काशि --> दीर्घ-तप --> धन्व, or also called as धन्वन्तरि... दीर्घ-तप was already old, but he undertook a long time ascesis and its end he got धन्वन्तरि, थे god of medicine, descended in human form, as his son...
verses.bhavadeepa: तानीति। जवनिकारूपैराक्षेपैरन्तर्द्धिकरैस्तिरोहिताधोभागानि रत्नौघैः क्लृप्तानि कृतानि प्रेक्षागाराणि ससानुप्रग्रहाणि उपरिदेशे सपताकानि खे सपक्षपर्वतवद्भान्तीत्यर्थः॥७॥

verses.sanskrit: गणिकानां पृथङ्मञ्चाः शुभैरास्तरणाम्बरैः। शोभिता वारमुख्याभिर्विमानप्रतिमौजसः॥९॥
verses.english: How and why god धन्वन्तरि incarnated as human... I would like to listen about it... please tell me the details...

verses.sanskrit: तत्रासनानि ख्यातानि पर्यङ्काश्च हिरण्मयाः। प्रकीर्णाश्च कुथाश्चित्राः सपुष्पस्तबकैर्वृताः॥१०॥
verses.english: Oh, yes, I will tell you about the emanation of धन्वन्तरि... endowed with an all-round magnificence he originally emerged from the Milky Ocean while it was being churned for amrita... on emerging from ocean he stood fixedly before viShNu just meditating upon him waiting for assignment of duties... and viShNu said lo him, because you are born out of an ocean, your will be known as अब्ज, oceans kin... thus dhanvantari is also known as अब्ज, reminiscent of brahma...

verses.sanskrit: सौवर्णाः पानकुम्भाश्च पानभूम्यश्च शोभिताः। फलावदंशपूर्णाश्च चाङ्गेर्यः पानयोजिताः॥११॥
verses.english: Studying Ayur-veda from sage bharadwAja, he segregated medical practise into eight categories, and taught the same to his medicos...

verses.sanskrit: अन्ये च मञ्चा बहवः काष्ठसञ्चयबन्धनाः। रेजुः प्रस्तरणास्तत्र शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः॥१२॥
verses.english: What for nikumbha cursed the city of kAshi... being a righteous entity how could nikumbha curse a holy place like kAshi...
verses.bhavadeepa: फलावदंशाः जम्बीराद्युपदंशास्तैः पूर्णाः चाङ्गेर्यः चुक्रिकादिपानरसाः पानयोजिताः पानार्थं स्थापिताः॥११॥

verses.sanskrit: उत्तमागारिकाश्चैव सूक्ष्मजालावलोकिनः। स्त्रीणां प्रेक्षागृहा भान्ति राजहंसा इवाम्बरे॥१३॥
verses.english: In your second emergence you will attain reputation in consideration of your undertaking, and to make your undertaking feasible, you will attain certain potentialities, like the eightfold yogic capabilities अणिम, लघिम, महिम etc., in your foetal state itself... by that alone, by your second emergence alone, you will attain godhood, whereafter brAhmaNa-s will look up to you with potions, hymns, religious observances, meditation etc...

verses.sanskrit: प्राङ्मुखश्चारुनिर्युक्तो मेरुशृङ्गसमप्रभः। रुक्मपत्रनिभस्तम्भश्चित्रनिर्योगशोभितः॥१४॥
verses.english: Because hitherto uncommon disease is going to become a common feature from the later part of dwApara era, you have to segregate Ayur-veda, the health-science, into eight broad categories for an easy applicability... brahma thought all these things beforehand and facilitated your emergence... hence, without a second thought, you have take up your second emergence in the forthcoming second dwApara era to help living beings on earth... let us talk about placements and offertories later... giving this boonlike entrustment to dhanvantari, viShNu vanished there itself...
verses.bhavadeepa: उत्तमागारिकाः गृहोपरि गृहं यत्तदुत्तमागारं तत्र भवाः। सूक्ष्मजालद्वारावलोको यस्तद्वन्तः। प्रेक्षागृहाः प्रेक्षार्थी गृहाः॥१३॥

verses.sanskrit: प्रेक्षागारः स कंसस्य प्रचकाशेऽधिकं श्रिया। शोभितो माल्यदामैश्च निवासकृतलक्षणः॥१५॥
verses.english: When the second dwApara era has come, the descendant of sunahotra who at that time is the king of kAshi province, namely दीर्घ-तप, is sonless... on deliberating much as to which god is to be propitiated... which god gives which kind of son, etc pros and cons, that king finally meditated upon dhanvantari seeking bestowal of a son...
verses.bhavadeepa: प्राङ्मुखः प्रेक्षागारः कंसस्य चकाशे इति द्वयोः सम्बन्धः॥१४॥

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन्नानाजनाकीर्णे जनौघप्रतिनादिते। समाजवाटे संस्तब्धे कम्पमानार्णावप्रभे॥१६॥
verses.english: Pleased with his ascesis dhanvantari appered before him and said, Oh, king, whatever boon you wish to ask, you may ask... I will grant it...

verses.sanskrit: राजा कुवलयापीडः समाजद्वारि कुञ्जरः। तिष्ठत्विति समाज्ञाप्य प्रेक्षागारमुपाययौ॥१७॥
verses.english: After sometime queen दृषद्वति delivered a valiant son of divbodasa, named prince प्रतर्दन, who even before attaining an age of combatant, but just by his might won kAshi back from दुर्दम॥।

verses.sanskrit: स शुक्ले वाससी बिभ्रच्छ्वेतव्यजनचामरः। शुशुभे श्वेतमुकुटः श्वेताभ्र इव चन्द्रमाः॥१८॥
verses.english: Studying Ayur-veda from sage bharadwAja, he segregated medical practise into eight categories, and taught the same to his medicos...

verses.sanskrit: तस्य सिंहासनस्थस्य सुखासीनस्य धीमतः। रूपमप्रतिमं दृष्ट्वा पौराः प्रोचुर्जयाशिषः॥१९॥
verses.english: Thus, this is the twenty-ninth chapter of first canto called harivamsha-parva, in harivamsha-purANa, the sequel of mahAbhArata, narrating the legend of divodAsa, the king of kAshi.

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रविविशुर्मल्ला रङ्गमावलिताम्बराः। तिस्रश्च भागशः कक्षाः प्राविशन्बलशालिनः॥२०॥
verses.english: But the city of kAshi became desolated when divodasa was ruling it, owing to a curse of निकुम्भ, an ethereal-attendant of god shiva, who cursed it to remain desolated for a thousand years to come... helpless divodasa also left the uninhibited city kAshi when it is reeling under curse, and lived in a cosy dwelling at गोमति, on the fringes of kAshi... at that time, even a demon named क्शेमक sneaked into that depopulated city to dwell...

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तूर्यनिनदेन क्ष्वेडितास्फोटितेन च। वसुदेवसुतौ हृष्टौ रङ्गद्वारमुपस्थितौ॥२१॥
verses.english: Even earlier to divodasas taking the reins of kAshi, a king named भद्र-श्रेण्य was ruling kAshi, usurping it from the ancestors of divodasa... this भद्र-श्रेण्य is from यदु dynasty and he is the son of king महिSमन्त॥॥ vanquishing that king भद्र-श्रेण्य and all his hundred sons who are famed as great archers, divodasa regained kAshi from him just by his own might, leaving off the last son of that king, called दुर्दम, because he was too young to be eradicated at that time... later, the calamity on kAshi has befallen...

verses.sanskrit: बल्लवौ वस्त्रसंवीतौ सुरवन्दनभूषितौ। ऊर्ध्वपीडौ स्रगापीडौ बाहुशस्त्रकृतौ यमौ। आस्फोटयन्तावन्योन्यं बाहू चैवार्गलोपमौ॥२२॥
तावापतन्तौ त्वरितौ प्रतिषिद्धौ वराननौ। तेन मत्तेन नागेन चोद्यमानेन वै भृशम्॥२३॥
verses.english: At the time when the kingly sage divodasa was ruling from the most affluent city kAshi, god shiva marrying goddess pArvati remained in his father-in-laws house, namely near at Himalayas, for sometime, just to please his new bride...

verses.sanskrit: स मत्तहस्ती दुष्टात्मा कृत्वा कुण्डलिनं करम्। चकार चोदितो यत्नं निहन्तुं बलकेशवौ॥२४॥
verses.english: Prior to this episode of kAshis depopulation /repopulation, divodasa regained kAshi from its usurper named king bhadrashreNya, by eliminating him and all of his sons, excepting the last one, named दुर्दम, showing usual clemency towards the young, at that time...

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रहसितः कृष्णस्त्रास्यमानो गजेन वै। कंसस्य तन्मतं चैव जगर्हे स दुरात्मनः॥२५॥
verses.english: Your husband, महेश्वर, is an eternalized good-for-nothing fellow... he and his gang - all are with outr behaviour, and none can bring him around to conduct himself with some etiquette...

verses.sanskrit: त्वरते खलु कंसोऽयं गन्तुं वैवस्वतक्षयम्। यो मामनेन नागेन प्रधर्षयितुमिच्छति॥२६॥
verses.english: When her mother insinuated shiva in this way, pArvati felt insulted for sullying shiva... pArvati recollected what has happened to her father daksha, who was her father in her earlier incarnation, and who similarly disparaged shiva then... fearing the same might happen to her present mother, lady मेन-देवि also, if she continued to belittle shiva in this way, pArvati suppressed her resentment with a smile and approached shiva, and standing at his side she spoke to him, I cannot stay here anymore, my lord, please take me to your house... which is impalpable...

verses.sanskrit: सन्निकृष्टे ततो नागे गर्जमाने तथा घने। सहसोत्पत्य गोविन्दश्चक्रे तालस्वनं प्रभुः॥२७॥
verses.english: As with any other newly-wed who starts searching for at least a single room tenement to start his wedded life, this houseless god shiva too started searching for an accommodation in all the worlds, and finally settled upon earth to start with... to make the dreams of her new bride to come true, and even with a bent for the prospective holy place kAshi, which is now under the governance of divodasa, shiva preferred it among all places on earth...

verses.sanskrit: क्ष्वेडितास्फोटितरवं कृत्वा नागस्य चाग्रतः। करं ससीकरं तस्य प्रतिजग्राह वक्षसा॥२८॥
विषाणान्तरगो भूत्वा पुनश्चरणमध्यगः। बबाधे तं गजं कृष्णः पवनस्तोयदं यथा॥२९॥
verses.english: Accordingly nikumbha went to kAshi and revealed himself to a barber named कण्डुक in his dream saying, oh, faultless one, I will do some favour to you, if you could show me some place to stay... if agreed, make a statue of my features and install it at the entrance to this city...

verses.sanskrit: स हस्ताग्राद्विनिष्क्रान्तो विषाणाग्राच्च दन्तिनः। विमुक्तः पदमध्याच्च कृष्णो द्विजमपोथयत्॥३०॥
verses.english: On the next day morning, that barber went to the king divodasa and reported about his dream and nikumbhas assurance, seeking the help of the king... the king readily agreed for the negligible request and arranged for a sculpture of nikumbha, its installation at the entrance of city, and for its worship in a grand and uninterrupted way with sandal paste, incense, garlands, anointment, and with offertories of food and drinkables... and when all these are put together, it has become a rare spectacle...

verses.sanskrit: सोऽतिकायस्तु संमूढो हन्तुं कृष्णमशक्नुवन्। गजः स्वेष्वेव गात्रेषु मथ्यमानो ररास ह॥३१॥
verses.english: But the city of kAshi became desolated when divodasa was ruling it, owing to a curse of निकुम्भ, an ethereal-attendant of god shiva, who cursed it to remain desolated for a thousand years to come... helpless divodasa also left the uninhibited city kAshi when it is reeling under curse, and lived in a cosy dwelling at गोमति, on the fringes of kAshi... at that time, even a demon named क्शेमक sneaked into that depopulated city to dwell...

verses.sanskrit: पपात भूमौ जानुभ्यां दशनाभ्यां तुतोद च। मदं सुस्राव रोषाच्च घर्मापाये यथा घनः॥३२॥
verses.english: Lady सु-यश, the immaculate queen consort of king divodasa, also sought to worship this idol, and the king readily encouraged her, because they too are issueless... coming to the place where the idol is installed she performed grand worships seeking a son, but of no use... she has come again and again and performed worships, again of no use... somehow, that god has not shown grace upon her even after prolonged worshipping, and she remained issueless...

verses.sanskrit: कृष्णस्तु तेन नागेन क्रीडित्वा शिशुलीलया। निधनाय मतिं चक्रे कंसद्विष्टेन चेतसा॥३३॥
verses.english: Nikumbha, the god in the idol, avoided giving the king any progeny on certain ground and he said to himself, This king should cut up rough with us... then only our mission is feasible... let him loose temper first...
verses.bhavadeepa: दशनाभ्यां मूलतो भग्नाभ्यां तुतोद व्यथां प्राप॥३२॥

verses.sanskrit: स तस्य प्रमुखे पादं कृत्वा कुम्भादनन्तरम्। दोर्भ्यां विषाणमुत्पाट्य तेनैव प्राहरत्तदा॥३४॥
verses.english: After some time the king is enraged and thought, This all-bestowing demigod at the gateway of this city is bestowing whatever the city dwellers are asking, that too, scores and scores of boons... residing in my own city, receiving worship from my own subjects, yet he does not show his grace on me, but why... this poor lady, my queen, is persistently offering worships praying just for a son, all unavailingly... but, why there is no fair exchange with him... well... if there is no synergism between him and us, it will be inapt on our part to invest him there any further, especially right in the eyeshot vicinage of mine... it is better I pull down his establishment so that that malefactor exiles himself...

verses.sanskrit: स तेन वज्रकल्पेन स्वेन दन्तेन कुञ्जरः। हन्यमानः शकृन्मूत्रं मुमोचार्तो ररास ह॥३५॥
verses.english: Deciding in this way that king egotistical of his kingship brought down the temple establishment of that demigod with certain disesteem...

verses.sanskrit: कृष्णजर्जरिताङ्गस्य कुञ्जरस्यार्तचेतसः। कटाभ्यामति सुस्राव वेगवद्भूरि शोणितम्॥३६॥
verses.english: On seeing the razed temple that demigod nikumbha issued a curse to king divodasa saying, As you have turned out a well-intentioned god of house and home, let your city-dwellers also become so... let people forsake this city kAshi making it a godforsaken megalopolis, of course, for a thousand years to come...

verses.sanskrit: लाङ्गूलं चास्य वेगेन निश्चकर्ष हलायुधः। शैलपृष्ठार्धसल्लीनं वैनतेय इवोरगम्॥३७॥
verses.english: Having cursed the city nikimbha has returned to god shiva, but whole of city kAshi suddenly started to flee in all directions, so to speak....

verses.sanskrit: तेनैव गजदन्तेन कृष्णो हत्वा तु दन्तिनम्। जघानैकप्रहारेण गजारोहणमुल्बणम्॥३८॥
verses.english: In such a desolated city god shiva then established his hospice...

verses.sanskrit: सोर्तनादं महत्कृत्वा विदन्तो दन्तिनां वरः। पपात स महामात्रो वज्रभिन्न इवाचलः॥३९॥
verses.english: While shivA and shiva are staying in kAshi, in order to please her with the change of residence from that of her mothers house, pArvati again felt that place dry-as-dust... she again complained to shiva, I cannot stay here also, my lord, take me somewhere else... this she complained with a - गृह-विस्मयात् house; from astonishment; say, from an astonishment whether that place called kAshi is any house with some population, or whether it is a crematorium happily deprived of people... Here nIlakaNTha derives some advaita import of this conversation. That being the case, another way of reading is like this, by some parsing and using ellipses. This dialog of pArvati is an indirect goading to shiva. She is nagging at him in all her motherly affection, just to populate kAshi immediately, keeping the trifling curse at bay. She is saying to her husband: You say it is an अ+वि+मुक्त क्शेत्रम्= a place where ineligible will also get मुक्ति salvation. But here, whom do you मुक्ति-फ़्य्? Walls, pillars and slabs, or what... If some ग्रहीत, donee is there, then alone you can become दात, a donor... None is available here excepting you and your bhajan-kIratan party, who are all beyond सद्यो मुक्ति, क्रम मुक्ति or whatever... as such, first bring back my children home, make this city livable for them, then you can earbash me with your ununderstandable philosophies... a house minus our own people is not a house, nor you are a householder, not I am a housewife... if not, I will leave for my mothers place, which is my regular slogan... Then shiva said to her: Why do you overlook the sub-clause in the curse, a thousand year desolation... now I will square it with this city... dont bother... Meanwhile the thousand year stipulation as part of curse on kAshi is over and kAshi is repopulated, to which population this so-called mother gives food hence called अन्न-पूर्ण. Not that she just throws leftovers, or two morsels into the bowls of beggars, but she makes them to live, an enlivener अन्न is no doubt is food, but here figuratively it is अन्न+गत+प्राणि= food oriented living beings, whom she makes to live comfortably. Again, shiva is called here विश्व-नाथ; where विश्व does not always mean cosmos; it is people; peoples lord. In effect, this going and coming of people from and to kAshi is symbolic to the pilgrims who also come and go to and from kAshi. Hence, the saying: visit kAshi, at least, once in lifetime...

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तौ तोरणाङ्गानि प्रगृह्य रणकर्कशौ। गजस्य पादरक्षांश्च जघ्नतुः पुरुषर्षभौ॥४०॥
verses.english: I cannot be quartered in this house or that, as I keep going only with अविमुक्त, the enfranchised souls, and this kAshi is a place where souls become so... hence, the question of my moving to somewhere else does not arise, yet, you may proceed on your own, if you so wish... so said god shiva smilingly to pArvati. Therefore kAshi became a cardinal place for those who seek to become अविमुक्त-आत्मा-स्, enfranchised souls, as the god shiva personally denominated kAshi as a place to disembark souls on other shore... in this way, kAshi is imprecated, redeemed, resuscitated as a holiest place...

verses.sanskrit: तांश्च हत्वा विविशतुर्मध्यं रङ्गस्य तावुभौ। नासत्यावश्विनौ स्वर्गादवतीर्णाविवेच्छया॥४१॥
verses.english: This holy couple, shivA-shiva, will be available in that city in their palpable forms in three cyclic eras, namely क्ऱित, त्रेत, and द्वाप युग-s; when कलि era arrives their forms will become impalpable, though their presence is still there... this is how kAshi is depopulated and repopulated... thus vaishampAyana is continuing his narration to janamejaya.
verses.bhavadeepa: तोरणस्य बहिर्द्वारस्य अङ्गानि स्तम्भादीनि तोरणं वाहनं गजस्तस्याङ्गानीति दन्तद्वये द्वाभ्यां गृहीतमित्यन्ये॥४०॥

verses.sanskrit: वृष्ण्यन्धकाश्च भोजाश्च ददृशुर्वनमालिनौ। क्ष्वेडितोत्कृष्टनादेन बाह्वोरास्फोटितेन च। सिंहनादैश्च तालैश्च हर्षयामासतुर्जनम्॥४२॥
verses.english: Prior to this episode of kAshis depopulation /repopulation, divodasa regained kAshi from its usurper named king bhadrashreNya, by eliminating him and all of his sons, excepting the last one, named दुर्दम, showing usual clemency towards the young, at that time...

verses.sanskrit: तौ दृष्ट्वा भोजराजस्तु विषसाद वृथामतिः। पौराणामनुरागं च हर्षं चालक्ष्य भारत॥४३॥
verses.english: This boy दुर्दम has come of age in the meanwhile, forged alliance with हैहय-s, and recaptured kAshi kingdom that had been recaptured by divodasa from his father bhadrashreNya, which bhadrashreNya had earlier captured from the ancestors of divodasa... thus दुर्दम did his part in the long drawn feud between kAshi and other empires, and reclaimed kAshi as a patrimony... दुर्दम, the son of bhadrashreNya, has imposed this invasion on kAshi as retaliation of a true kshatriya...

verses.sanskrit: तं हत्वा पुण्डरीकाक्षो नदन्तं दन्तिनां वरम्। अवतीर्णोऽर्णवाकारं समाजं सहपूर्वजः॥४४॥
verses.english: As with any other newly-wed who starts searching for at least a single room tenement to start his wedded life, this houseless god shiva too started searching for an accommodation in all the worlds, and finally settled upon earth to start with... to make the dreams of her new bride to come true, and even with a bent for the prospective holy place kAshi, which is now under the governance of divodasa, shiva preferred it among all places on earth...
verses.bhavadeepa: भोजराजः कंसः विषसाद विषादं प्राप। तत्र हेत्वन्तरं पौराणामनुरागं च कृष्णे आलक्ष्य॥४३॥
